Speed, trim silence and volume boost — the densest control screen in the watch app.

The published-date and duration line, the smallest type in the watch app.
The persistent now-playing entry point at the head of the watch list.
The round play affordance on an episode screen.
All five download states stacked — not downloaded, queued, downloading, downloaded and errored.
The scrolling title/subtitle pair used where a track name overflows the watch's width.

The curved time text at the top of the bezel while the watch is connected.
The empty state: icon, title and explanatory copy sized for the watch.
